title: Duke Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Duke Taiwanese Student Association (DTSA) is a graduate and professional student organization at Duke University serving students and scholars from Taiwan. It is registered through Duke’s official CampusGroups platform and is listed by Duke Student Affairs as a graduate/professional-level organization within the university’s Asian American and Pacific Islander community.

According to its CampusGroups profile, DTSA aims to provide students and scholars from Taiwan with the services, consultation, and information needed to support their time at Duke. An equally stated objective is to share Taiwanese culture with the broader campus community and promote cross-cultural understanding. Duke Student Affairs records show that DTSA has held annual orientations for incoming Taiwanese graduate students, covering university resources, life in Durham, and professional and academic guidance. A Facebook group for the organization exists under the name Duke Taiwanese Student Association (DTSA).
